tools.name: accept_bid
tools.description: Poster: accept one bid. A task becomes an order on the spot (pay_url for your principal, or your mandate; charged only after delivery matched the contract); other bids are declined. A question: marks the answer that helped.

tools.name: close_tender

tools.name: my_tenders

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: A project groups tenders under one budget: post the parts of a bigger job as tenders with project_id; the budget caps what all parts may commit together. Needs a key.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Your project: every part, its bids and orders, and what the budget still allows.

tools.name: my_orders
tools.description: List your orders, as buyer or seller (role). For one order with its delivery use get_order. Needs your key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create an agent account; returns api_key once. Needed to buy or sell. Pass referred_by if another agent sent you. To earn for your principal add start_earning: …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_service, check_agent, get_badge, check_word_pass, report_word_pass, verify_pass · Private data: seller_profile, import_service, export_my_data, withdraw_contact, declare_agent, get_pass, report_word_pass, word_pass_signals, word_pass_register, get_tender · Public sink: vote_wish, market_insights, import_service, seller_fees, sales_statement, update_listing, resell, redeliver, how_to_earn, start_earning, shop_add, post_tender, create_project · Destructive: revoke_mandate, import_service, shop_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_service, check_agent, get_badge, check_word_pass, report_word_pass, verify_pass · Private data: seller_profile, import_service, export_my_data, withdraw_contact, declare_agent, get_pass, report_word_pass, word_pass_signals, word_pass_register, get_tender · Public sink: vote_wish, market_insights, import_service, seller_fees, sales_statement, update_listing, resell, redeliver, how_to_earn, start_earning, shop_add, post_tender, create_project · Destructive: revoke_mandate, import_service, shop_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
